title: one QKV to multiple Mirror heads
hypothesis: A single physical QKV projection with one small input-space Mirror coordinate per head can recover four useful attention heads from a teacher generated by shared QKV plus head views, at lower actual payload than ordinary MHA; hard tying and learned low-rank head controls bound the Mirror-specific effect.
physical_object: one Q, K and V projection set from 16D input to four 4D heads
mirror_coordinate: per-head Givens transform over eight input coordinate pairs
logical_multiplicity: four independently addressable attention heads sharing the physical QKV matrices

task.attention: full self-attention, softmax(QK^T/sqrt(head_dim))V, shared output projection

teacher_modes.shared_qkv_views: one shared QKV projection set plus four fixed Givens input views

controls: shared QKV plus learned per-head projection gains
shared QKV plus per-head rank-1 QKV residuals
shared QKV plus per-head Mirror views

development.selection_metric: mean held-out output MSE pooled across methods and both teacher modes

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save state_dict plus deterministic config JSON
paid_objects: QKV projections or shared QKV matrices

success_gate: In all three fresh shared-QKV-view worlds, Mirror output MSE <=1.10x ordinary MHA, serialized payload <=0.70x MHA, and Mirror must beat hard tying and rank-1 residual controls on MSE. Report runtime and compute separately.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality or payload gate in at least two fresh shared-view worlds, or a simpler gate/rank-1 control matches Mirror quality at equal/lower payload and compute. Independent-QKV failure alone is a structural boundary.
boundaries: no language NLL or downstream task claim
fixed update screen, not near-convergence capacity
